scripts.web:build: bun run web:generate-api && bun run --cwd web build
scripts.web:check: bun run web:check-generated && bun run --cwd web check
scripts.web:check-generated: bun run web:generate-api && git diff --exit-code -- web/src/api-client
scripts.web:generate-api: bun run web:export-openapi && bun run --cwd web generate:api
